requirements.text: A standalone consumer can install the candidate, add the mandated lock, and pass BOTH lock-consistency and exact payload verification.
A reinstall/upgrade retains the consumer lock (or it is deliberately regenerated); lock is not silently lost.
A separate extra non-lock file in the payload still fails exact integrity verification.
Equal, descendant and ancestor target/reference combinations are rejected BEFORE any replacement; sentinel project files are unchanged.
A disjoint sibling reference still installs successfully.
Missing, empty or invalid lock source_url is rejected with a stable failure.
A lock source_url that mismatches provenance.json gives a stable lock-payload-drift failure.
Matching supported URL, version, range and SHA cases keep passing.

non_goals: Fixing adjacent findings SQA-integrity-003..009 or 011 (sibling cards); they are only noted in the PR body if touched.
Changing standard/provenance_policy.md wording or installed v3.1.3 .nizam/ payload.
Release tagging, version bump, Mandate-2 or NXOS product work.
Making the baseline failures ac02, corrective and convergent green (pre-existing, unrelated, recorded in the lane log).
